records.text:
Transparency, accountability and record keeping are important parts of the role. As a Junior Procurement Officer, you will work in the Procurement team in Tokyo, Japan, reporting to a senior member of the team. This is a full-time opportunity.

Day-to-day responsibilities: Report on procurement spending and savings; Maintain procurement records and contract files; Prepare tender documents and manage competitive bidding; Monitor supplier delivery and contract performance; Handle routine Procurement assignments independently and ask for guidance on complex cases; Evaluate supplier submissions against published criteria.

We expect an associate degree in a relevant field, together with 1 to 2 years of relevant experience. Strong grounding in supplier sourcing, public procurement regulations, budget management, attention to detail, and Excel is expected. You must be able to work in Japanese and English.

It would be an advantage to bring enterprise resource planning and civil service procedures. The employer encourages applications from candidates of all backgrounds.

records.text:
A public-sector agency in Busan, South Korea is looking for a Human Resources Specialist to join its Human Resources team. Transparency, accountability and record keeping are important parts of the role. This role suits candidates with solid hands-on experience. The position follows a hybrid working pattern.

Main duties: (1) own Human Resources deliverables from planning through completion; (2) support recruitment, interviews and onboarding of new employees; (3) advise managers and staff on HR policies and procedures; (4) prepare workforce and HR reports; (5) maintain employee records and HR information systems; (6) handle employee relations cases with confidentiality.

We expect a master's degree in a relevant field, together with 3 to 6 years of relevant experience. Candidates must demonstrate industrial relations, labour regulations, HR software, verbal communication, recruitment and selection, and Microsoft Office. The working languages for this role are Korean.

Additional strengths in reward management, performance management, data analysis, or change management will be viewed favourably. The employer values reliability, integrity and a willingness to keep learning.
